newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's NDB bank raises capital.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's NDB bank raises capital.

text.p: Egypt's National Bank for Development (NBD) has decided to raise its issued capital to 200 million pounds ($58.9 million) from 150.6 million through a share offering, corporate sources said on Sunday.

The bank had said earlier that it was postponing the capital increase until the state sold a 30 percent stake in the bank. Last month, the state offered investors 600,000 shares, of which it sold 177,800 shares equivalent to 29.6 percent of the bank's equity, the sources said.

The capital increase was approved by an extraordinary general meeting. The bank will probably offer current shareholders extra shares to increase the capital, the sources said. If this share offer is not fully subscribed, the remaining shares will be sold through a public offer.
The date of the issue and other details were not available.
The shares last traded on the stock exchange at 22.00 pounds. The stock has a nominal value of 10.00 pounds.
